# bayesian-examples

The canonical Bayesian examples as methods a page or a worker runs by name and a few knobs: each rebuilds its data and model from the knobs (a model-bound inference method closes over its data, so the configuration is all that crosses a Worker boundary), takes one inference method from a table with its own knobs and a time budget, and reads the posterior at any step of the run through derived paths of its contract. `example-method.ts` is the scaffold they are declared on (`defineExample`); the examples so far are a biased coin (and counts), Bayesian linear regression, Bayesian classification of a two-dimensional data set (probit or logistic, polynomial features), eight schools, hierarchical radon and Gaussian process classification.

- estimator `classifier-method.ts` (file): Bayesian probit or logistic classifier on 2-D data: one chosen inference method with its knobs. `src/lib/bayesian-examples/classifier-method.ts:1` `omai-engine/bayesian-examples`
- estimator `coin-method.ts` (file): Biased coin (Beta-Bernoulli) or counts (Gamma-Poisson): one inference method checked against the exact posterior. `src/lib/bayesian-examples/coin-method.ts:1` `omai-engine/bayesian-examples`
- estimator `eight-schools-method.ts` (file): Eight schools hierarchical model (centred, non-centred, pooled, unpooled): data, model and inference as knobs. `src/lib/bayesian-examples/eight-schools-method.ts:1` `omai-engine/bayesian-examples`
- estimator `gp-classification-method.ts` (file): Gaussian process classification: latent GP, Bernoulli link, one inference method, NUTS reference. `src/lib/bayesian-examples/gp-classification-method.ts:1` `omai-engine/bayesian-examples`
- estimator `irt-method.ts` (file): Item response theory example: Rasch or 2PL, population priors, known truth. `src/lib/bayesian-examples/irt-method.ts:1` `omai-engine/bayesian-examples`

- estimator `radon-method.ts` (file): Hierarchical radon (pooled, unpooled, partial pooling, varying slopes) over counties of unequal size. `src/lib/bayesian-examples/radon-method.ts:1` `omai-engine/bayesian-examples`
- estimator `robust-regression-method.ts` (file): Robust regression: outliers in a line, Gaussian, Student-t, Laplace or mixture likelihood, one inference method. `src/lib/bayesian-examples/robust-regression-method.ts:1` `omai-engine/bayesian-examples`
- estimator `stochastic-volatility-method.ts` (file): Stochastic volatility: returns with an AR(1) log-variance, centred or non-centred, one inference method, checked. `src/lib/bayesian-examples/stochastic-volatility-method.ts:1` `omai-engine/bayesian-examples`
